question: A can do a piece of work in 12 days, B can do the same work in 15 days. C can do the same work in 9 days. The time taken by them to finish the same work if they work together is:
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work in 12 days; B can do the same work in 15 days. C can do the same work in 9 days

**Calculation:**

According to the question, 

A can do a work in 12 days.

so, A work for one day = 1over 12

B can do a work in 15 days

so, B work for one day = 1over15

C can do work in 9 days

so, C work for one day = 1over9

0n adding all.

(A + B + C) work in one day = (1over 12) + (1over15) + (1over9)

⇒ 15 + 12+20over180 = 47over180

A, B and C together can finish work = 180over47

A, B and C together can finish work in one day = 47over180 = ​3{39over 47} days​

**The time taken by them to finish the same work if they work together is ​'**3{39over 47}** days'.**
